title: Part Library entries from before the release stay listed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a Part Library entry from before this release, entry A, that no part uses ("Total parts" 0).
  • Have a second Part Library entry from before this release, entry B, that a part uses.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Type entry A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the entry A row.
  3. Click Parts in the top bar.
  4. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  5. Type entry B's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Entry A is still listed, although nothing uses it.

Step 2:

  • Its detail page opens and shows "Total parts" 0: the release neither deleted nor hid it.

Step 3:

  • The Parts left menu shows Part Library.

Step 4:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 5:

  • Entry B is still listed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only)

  • S11-E1: “Part Library entries that exist on the day of release stay in the list, including the ones nothing references. This spec does not delete or hide them.”
  • Story 11, context note: “Context note: in the reference dataset 29,376 Part Library entries, 19,664 with no inventory part, and 17,359 with no inventory part and no part request either. No standalone create is what keeps that number from growing.”
